about.label: About Us
about.heading: A Madurai travel crew, not a call centre.
body: Pack & Go Agency started with a simple idea — that planning a holiday shouldn't be more stressful than the work you're escaping from. We handle the stays, the transport, the route, and the stops worth making.

Most people come to us knowing the feeling they want, not the place — a food trip, a temple circuit, a week on a beach, something the kids will remember. So that's how this page is laid out. Pick the category, then the place.
We're based in Madurai and we travel these routes ourselves. Ask us anything before you commit — no pressure, and nothing in the quote you didn't ask for.
about._note_stats: "count" pulls the number live from destinations.json so these tiles can't drift when you add or remove a place. Use a plain "value" instead for a fixed number — but only one you can back up.

features.heading: Affordable Daily Rates

whyUs.label: Why Pack & Go
whyUs.heading: Six reasons people book with us twice.

items.heading: India and overseas
items.text: One team whether you're going to Rameswaram or Bali. You don't need a second agent for the second half of the year.

items.heading: Fully customisable
items.text: Change the hotel, the dates, the route. The plan bends to you.

items.heading: Transparent pricing
items.text: You see what's included and what isn't, before you pay a rupee.

items.heading: Local Tamil-speaking team
items.text: Talk to us in Tamil or English. No scripts, no runaround.

items.heading: Trips and rentals
items.text: The full trip, or just a vehicle out of Madurai — your choice.

items.heading: Reachable during the trip
items.text: Something goes wrong at 11pm in Munnar? You still get a person on the phone.

steps.heading: Tell us your plan
steps.text: Message us on WhatsApp with the destination — or just the category — your dates, and how many people are travelling.

steps.heading: Get your itinerary
steps.text: We send back a day-wise plan and a full quote. Change anything you like until it's right.

steps.heading: Confirm and go
steps.text: Pay the advance, get your confirmation, and turn up with your bags. We handle everything else.
